messages:
From: Amos Greene <amos@openweights.org>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: evelyn.shaw@openweights.org
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: distribution & access terms for OpenWeights models

Hi Laura and Sergio,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — we appreciated the concrete notes on routing and the KV cache behavior. OpenWeights Collective is interested in a lightweight distribution partnership so our community models can be discoverable and served through Redwood Dedicated and Hosted offerings.

Attached is a rough term sheet (OW-weights-access-term-sheet.docx) that covers the basics we usually propose: rev-share on inference usage, attribution/branding guidelines, and a two-tier access model (public metadata + gated weights access for partners). A couple of open points for us:
- whether Redwood requires an exclusivity window for certain enterprise customers;
- telemetry/usage reporting cadence and format;
- suggested security controls for gated weights (KMS, IP allowlists).

We'd like to align on a short mutual action plan and next steps. Are you available for a 30-minute sync this week?

Best,
Amos Greene
Head of Partnerships
OpenWeights Collective
attachments: OW-weights-access-term-sheet.docx
From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Amos Greene <amos@openweights.org>
Cc: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, camila_reyes <camila@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: distribution & access terms for OpenWeights models

Amos — thanks for the doc and the clear framing. Sharing a few quick notes up front and then happy to book a short call:

- Exclusivity: our default is non-exclusive; we handle custom carve-outs on a customer-by-customer basis with a short notice period.
- Reporting: we can provide daily aggregate usage (tokens, calls, model variant) and a monthly CSV export. Need to confirm what fields you need.
- Gated weights: Redwood Private/Dedicated supports customer-controlled KMS and IP allowlists; for Hosted we can offer signed access tokens and time-limited downloads for partners on approved contracts.

Proposed mutual action plan:
1) Legal handshake (NDA) — attach your NDA or we can send ours.
2) Technical integration call (30m) — propose Thu 7/23 or Fri 7/24.
3) Pilot: one model with volume cap and reporting for 60 days.

I've looped in Camila to help coordinate publisher terms and Priyom for any hosting SLA/pricing questions. Sergio — quick ask: can you sketch typical rev-share bands we see for open publisher partnerships (low, mid, high usage)?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Business Development, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
--

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: distribution & access terms for OpenWeights models

Quick input from commercial:
- Rev-share bands (ballpark for publisher models):
  * Low usage (community/demo): 10-15% of net infra revenue
  * Mid usage (SMB integrations): 18-25%
  * High usage (enterprise / revenue generating): 25-35% + potential flat fee component
- Minimum guarantees are rare for open publishers; we can offer minimum monthly commitments for dedicated pools when customers want guaranteed capacity.
- Pricing clarity: need to lock down what counts as billable usage for the rev-share (tokens served vs inference compute cost vs subscription).

I'll prepare a short commercial term memo and share an estimated range for the pilot pricing.

— Sergio
VP Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Amos Greene <amos@openweights.org>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, camila_reyes <camila@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: distribution & access terms for OpenWeights models

Laura / team — thanks for the speedy replies. A few clarifications inline:

- NDA: please find our standard NDA attached (OpenWeights_NDA_v2.pdf). We're fine with your non-exclusive approach.
- Reporting fields: token_count, model_id, region, customer_hubspot_id (if available), daily_timestamp. I've attached a small sample (usage_metrics_sample.csv).
- Rev-share: the attached term sheet proposes a 20% rev-share on gross inference revenue for the pilot model, with an escalation to 30% if monthly inference revenue exceeds $75k. We're open to negotiating a hybrid (flat + rev-share) if that simplifies billing.
- DocuSign: I can route a simple agreement once we align. Link: https://www.docusign.com/doc/OW-Agreement-2026

Call availability: Fri 7/24 at 11:00 PT works for us.

Thanks,
Amos
Head of Partnerships, OpenWeights Collective

Subject: Fwd: Proposal: distribution & access terms for OpenWeights models — internal summary and next steps

Team — summary after Amos' response and the call scheduling:

What we have
- Publisher: OpenWeights Collective; pilot model, non-exclusive
- Proposed commercial: pilot rev-share starts at 20% with escalation at $75k/mo to 30% (open to hybrid)
- Reporting: daily CSV with token_count, model_id, region, customer_hubspot_id, date
- Security: gated weights via signed tokens for Hosted; KMS + allowlists for Dedicated/Private

Open questions / asks
1) Legal review: Priyom, please confirm any concerns on the attached NDA and term-sheet language (IP, liability, export controls).
2) Commercial approval: Sergio, please confirm the proposed bands look reasonable and whether we should propose a small pilot flat fee to reduce complexity for the publisher.
3) Technical ops: Camila, after NDA executes, please prioritize a short integration runbook and define the mechanics for signed token access and telemetry hooks.

Goal: sign NDA and kick technical pilot before end of Aug. If everyone is aligned, I'll confirm the DocuSign routing with Amos on Thu 7/30.

Thanks — Laura
Head of Business Development
Redwood Inference
